#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Edge;

struct Node {
    vector<Edge*> edges;
    int index;
    
    Node() : index(-1) {}
};

struct Edge {
    bool forward;
    Node* from;
    Node* to;
    ll flow;
    const ll capacity;
    Edge* dual;
    ll cost;
    
    Edge(Node* s, Node* d, ll c, bool f) 
        : forward(f), from(s), to(d), flow(0), capacity(c), dual(nullptr), cost(0) {}
    
    ll remaining() const { return capacity - flow; }
    
    void addFlow(ll amount) {
        flow += amount;
        dual->flow -= amount;
    }
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
protected:
    vector<Node*> nodes;
    
public:
    MaxFlowSolver() {}
    MaxFlowSolver(int n) { for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) addNode(); }
    
    void link(Node* n1, Node* n2, ll capacity) {
        link(n1, n2, capacity, 1);
    }
    
    void link(Node* n1, Node* n2, ll capacity, ll cost) {
        Edge* e12 = new Edge(n1, n2, capacity, true);
        Edge* e21 = new Edge(n2, n1, 0, false);
        e12->dual = e21;
        e21->dual = e12;
        n1->edges.push_back(e12);
        n2->edges.push_back(e21);
        e12->cost = cost;
        e21->cost = -cost;
    }
    
    virtual ~MaxFlowSolver() {
        for (auto node : nodes) {
            for (auto edge : node->edges) {
                delete edge;
            }
            delete node;
        }
    }
    
    virtual ll getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
    
    Node* addNode() {
        Node* n = new Node();
        n->index = nodes.size();
        nodes.push_back(n);
        return n;
    }
    
    int size() const { return nodes.size(); }
};

class MinCostMaxFlowSolver : public MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver() : MaxFlowSolver() {}
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver(int n) : MaxFlowSolver(n) {}
    
    virtual ~MinCostMaxFlowSolver() {}
    
    virtual vector<ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
};

class EdmondsKarp : public MinCostMaxFlowSolver {
private:
    ll minCost;
    
    struct Item {
        ll dist;
        int v;
        
        Item(ll d, int vertex) : dist(d), v(vertex) {}
        
        bool operator<(const Item& other) const {
            return dist > other.dist;
        }
    };
    
public:
    EdmondsKarp() : MinCostMaxFlowSolver(), minCost(0) {}
    EdmondsKarp(int n) : MinCostMaxFlowSolver(n), minCost(0) {}
    
    ~EdmondsKarp() {}
    
    vector<ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        ll maxflow = getMaxFlow(src, snk);
        return {maxflow, minCost};
    }
    
    static const ll INF = LLONG_MAX / 4;
    
    ll getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        const int n = nodes.size();
        const int source = src->index;
        const int sink = snk->index;
        ll flow = 0;
        ll cost = 0;
        vector<ll> potential(n, 0);
        
        while (true) {
            vector<Edge*> parent(n, nullptr);
            vector<ll> dist(n, INF);
            priority_queue<Item> que;
            
            dist[source] = 0;
            que.push(Item(0, source));
            
            while (!que.empty()) {
                Item item = que.top();
                que.pop();
                
                if (item.dist != dist[item.v])
                    continue;
                
                for (Edge* e : nodes[item.v]->edges) {
                    if (e->capacity > e->flow) {
                        ll temp = dist[item.v] + e->cost + potential[item.v] - potential[e->to->index];
                        if (temp < dist[e->to->index]) {
                            dist[e->to->index] = temp;
                            parent[e->to->index] = e;
                            que.push(Item(temp, e->to->index));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (parent[sink] == nullptr)
                break;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (parent[i] != nullptr) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
            }
            
            ll augFlow = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index) {
                augFlow = min(augFlow, parent[i]->capacity - parent[i]->flow);
            }
            
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index) {
                Edge* e = parent[i];
                e->addFlow(augFlow);
                cost += augFlow * e->cost;
            }
            
            flow += augFlow;
        }
        
        minCost = cost;
        return flow;
    }
};

class FastScanner {
private:
    istream* in;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;
    
public:
    FastScanner(istream& input) : in(&input), buffer(""), pos(0) {}
    FastScanner() : in(&cin), buffer(""), pos(0) {}
    
    string next() {
        while (pos == buffer.size()) {
            if (!(*in).getline(buffer)) {
                return "";
            }
            pos = 0;
        }
        
        while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) {
            pos++;
        }
        
        size_t start = pos;
        while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) {
            pos++;
        }
        
        return buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner scanner;
    int N = scanner.nextInt();
    int M = scanner.nextInt();
    int K = scanner.nextInt();
    int C = scanner.nextInt();
    int D = scanner.nextInt();
    
    EdmondsKarp solver;
    
    vector<int> people(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        people[i] = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
    }
    
    Node* src = solver.addNode();
    Node* snk = solver.addNode();
    
    int amt = 150;
    vector<vector<Node*>> timeNodes(N, vector<Node*>(amt, nullptr));
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < amt; j++) {
            timeNodes[i][j] = solver.addNode();
            if (j > 1) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[i][j-1], timeNodes[i][j], LLONG_MAX, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        solver.link(src, timeNodes[people[i]][1], 1, 0);
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i < amt; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            solver.link(timeNodes[0][i], snk, 1, C * i - C);
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        int a = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        int b = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        
        for (int j = 1; j < amt - 1; j++) {
            ll prev = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[a][j], timeNodes[b][j + 1], 1, D * k * k - prev);
                solver.link(timeNodes[b][j], timeNodes[a][j + 1], 1, D * k * k - prev);
                prev = D * k * k;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<ll> ret = solver.getMinCostMaxFlow(src, snk);
    cout << ret[1] << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
